text: Just got back from the most incredible hike! Started at dawn, the trail was covered in morning dew. About halfway up I realized I forgot my water bottle in the car - rookie mistake. But honestly? Best decision ever. Forced me to take it slow, really soak in the views. Met this couple at the summit who'd been coming here for 20 years. They shared their coffee with me (lifesavers!) and told me about this hidden trail that leads to an even better viewpoint. Didn't have time today but definitely going back next weekend. My legs are killing me right now but 100% worth it. Sometimes the unplanned stuff turns out to be the best part of the day.
